display_name: Employment Insurance Act and Regulations: the whole text of both, layer 1 and a seat for a person who has lost work or cannot work
seat: a person who has lost work, or cannot work because of sickness, pregnancy, caring for a child or a family member, or who is self-employed or a fisher, asking whether they qualify for Employment Insurance benefits, how many hours or weeks they need, how much they would receive and for how long, and what they must do or tell the Commission.
edition: Employment Insurance Act (S.C. 1996, c. 23), consolidation current to 2026-09-30, last amended 2026-06-18 (Justice Laws consolidation date), from a plain-text rendering (../../registers/source-bundle/S.C.-1996-c.-23.txt, text_sha256 6d427117bf1a6583d5791b6e5cc6f851c02a1ab3939de37e4fa8dce562e22876); Employment Insurance Regulations (SOR/96-332), consolidation current to 2026-09-30, last amended 2026-04-01 (Justice Laws consolidation date), from a plain-text rendering (../../registers/source-bundle/SOR-96-332.txt, text_sha256 c7918da6019459f89227a4946c2e4a1ab9cd91025285973533abeec3861e5f6a); not the official text
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The text is a plain-text rendering, not the official text, and has not been checked against it. The tests' expected values were written by the encoders from the text, not by an independent author. The pieces were written in parallel and are not wired to each other: a rule that depends on a provision in another piece takes it as an input (see Cross-references out of my ranges in each NOTES-<agent>.md).

check_sh_output: target: main. Each module is run with your l4 and with the main build below; the main columns must match.
module                                    errors satisfied  failed  refused  expected | errors satisfied  failed  refused  main
(a failed assertion is also an error; any other error, or any refused assertion, makes the run red)

(target main: every module has the same four counts on the main build. That rules out a module main rejects and a difference an assertion shows; it does not see a different TRACE outcome, or any difference no assertion exercises)

scope.intent: the whole text of the Act and of its Regulations, as deposited in registers/source-bundle, divided into pieces along their own divisions
